_comment: Reference shape for <repo>/.codex/hooks.json. The installer generates a copy of this with real interpreter and script paths; do not hand-edit the generated file unless you also re-run the installer. JSON keys are camelCase (commandWindows); TOML config.toml accepts command_windows. The SessionStart matcher includes 'compact', which is what covers the window after compaction.
description: Project state injection and one-shot state nudge for the Sol + DeepSeek thin-root workflow.
